title: a scheduled job of this profile stopped firing (or fails on every run)
evidence: 3 job(s) fire and FAIL every run: tc-overnight-watchdog 3 consecutive failure(s), last_status='error', last_error=Owner process is still alive but the claim outlived the derived stale bound; treated as wedged (#115692). The process wa; tc-ops-triage 71 consecutive failure(s), last_status='error', last_error=Owner process is still alive but the claim outlived the derived stale bound; treated as wedged (#115692). The process wa; tc-corpus-backup 2 consecutive failure(s), last_status='error', last_error=RuntimeError: Connection error.. Both are producer states the consumer side cannot tell from a healthy quiet job, so read the producer's own error channel before anything else: cron/executions.db for an error row against that job id, then its output file under cron/output/<job-id>/ for an exception raised inside the task. Recovery for a stall is in-repo -- force-run the job, then confirm the NEXT slot's run actually lands; a job that keeps missing its slot after a force-run is the documented Hermes scheduler gap, whose fallback is a systemd user timer (`systemctl --user enable --now <name>.timer`, OnCalendar=*:0/5) running the same command. A whole-fleet stall is invisible here by construction -- no run means no probe.

notes.note: 2026-09-29 17:4xZ ops-triage: root cause diagnosed and VERIFIED RECOVERED; no in-repo fix available or warranted. Two distinct producer faults, both transient: (1) 'RuntimeError: Connection error' on brain+triage = the shared max395 Qwen3.8-27B endpoint (custom:max395) degraded 09-27..09-29 (genome #24 shared-endpoint cascade; the earlier 'rejected as too large' at 8k-97k tokens was the same). Verified this pass with a REAL completion against the :8080 endpoint: HTTP 200, 71 tokens in 8.9s -> it is serving again. (2) 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named ruamel' on watchdog+corpus-backup = the Hermes 0.21.4->0.21.5 version bump severed the site-packages .pth bridge (genome update-window bridge severance). Verified the CURRENT venv (161a25e5...) imports ruamel 0.18.16 fine -> the bridge was re-established; the dispatch path is healthy (this run dispatched). Neither fault lives in this repo: the endpoint is fleet-shared and the bridge is Hermes-internal, so there is no root-cause edit to make here. The probe is doing its job -- it fired, named the producer states, and it self-closes as failure_streak resets (this run landing ok resets triage to 0; brain next 16:00, watchdog next 22:10).
